messages:
mike.leclerc: quick check — i'm about to land a terraform diff that changes how we map vault paths for the payments service in the overlay. moving from per-namespace -> per-service kv path, and adding an annotation for rotation-policy. sample tf snippet:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "payments_vault" {
  metadata {
    name = "payments-credentials"
    annotations = {
      "redwood.com/rotation-policy" = "daily"
      "redwood.com/vault-path" = "kv/data/services/payments"
    }
    namespace = var.payments_ns
  }
  data = { ... }
}
```

mike.leclerc: two questions — (1) does the rotation annotation need to be on the ExternalSecret CR instead? (2) will this break any existing mount paths for legacy jobs?

anya.k: for (1) we generally put rotation control on the ExternalSecret so the controller can pick it up, but putting metadata on the k8s Secret as a fallback is fine. prefer controller-level annotation to avoid drift.

jo-chen: for (2) legacy jobs expect /etc/creds/payments.json via projected secret; changing vault path shouldn't affect the mount as long as secret name stays payments-credentials. only risk is if you change keys inside the secret.

sre-oncall: FYI the rotation lambda reads the annotation "redwood.com/rotation-policy" from the ExternalSecret on the create/update webhook. if you move annotation to k8s secret we won't see it. recommend keeping it on ExternalSecret.

mike.leclerc: ok i'll update tf to write annotation on externalsecret resource instead of k8s secret. sample helm values i'm planning to set:

```yaml
externalsecret:
  name: payments-es
  annotations:
    redwood.com/rotation-policy: "daily"
  spec:
    remoteRef: "kv/data/services/payments"
```

ci-bot: terraform plan OK — no resources will be destroyed. 1 modified, 2 added.

anya.k: quick nit — ensure the TF has a migration script to copy old kv paths to new service path or add a post-apply job. otherwise rotation will start hitting the new keys empty.

mike.leclerc: good catch. i'll add a k8s job in the overlay that runs a small script to copy secrets if present, then mark migration complete with a configmap flag.

jo-chen: ping me for a quick review after you push, i'll check mounts and the job permissions.

mike.leclerc: thanks. landing PR in ~30m. @sre-oncall can you monitor rotation runs after the deploy? :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: yep I'll watch logs and alerting, will post any anomalies here.

deploy-bot: deployment started for overlay/payments @1787654375

mike.leclerc: thanks everyone — will follow up once migration job runs.
